avoid_dishes.reason: Tare is normally regular soy plus mirin. Ask for salt-only (shio) skewers.

avoid_dishes.dish: Tempura / crunchy rolls, kanikama rolls, eel

avoid_dishes.reason: Miso/soy marinades are likely to contain gluten

name: SushiYaki
questions: Do you still have GF soy sauce?
Can yakitori be done salt-only, without tare?
Which rolls contain tempura flakes or kanikama?

safe_dishes.dish: Sashimi, plain nigiri, simple fish/veg maki
safe_dishes.note: With the GF soy sauce. Staff suggested modifications.

summary: A celiac reviewer reports GF soy sauce and helpful staff. There's no GF menu, so order simple sushi.
tamari_source: A celiac reviewer on FindMeGlutenFree said they had gluten-free soya sauce and staff helped modify dishes. FMGF Dubai lists it under GF soy sauce. It has no GF menu.
